parameters.description:
Send a notification to your own PopcornNotify destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

`msg-to-popcornnotify` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your PopcornNotify destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through [Apprise](https://github.com/caronc/apprise) — the open-source notification library — or a native gateway transformation, both free and driven entirely by your own stored credentials. Paid variants ($0.001 per message) deliver to additional PopcornNotify destinations bound per enrollment.
parameters.gateway_body_template: message={* _escape_json((_body.title or "")..(((_body.title or "")~="" and (_body.body or "")~="") and ": " or "")..(_body.body or "")) *}&recipients=${ customer_secrets.POPCORNNOTIFY_RECIPIENTS }
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment PopcornNotify recipients, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your PopcornNotify recipients

apikey_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's PopcornNotify apikey

targets_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's PopcornNotify targets
